about: Which layer wins when a park's layers disagree (KPC owner, 2026-11-14: the state / agency's own layer over PAD-US). Best first, one list per area; '*' = every layer not named; 'default' is used for an area with no list. Edit freely: tools/kpc_display_copy.py reads this file. The winner per park is written into the display copy's INDEX.json ('won').
